title: montiopsis gayana
intro: Montiopsis gayana, commonly known as Gayanea or Chilean lavender, is a flowering plant species native to the southern Andes region. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing anxiety and insomnia due to its calming effects, which can be attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic properties. The therapeutic actions of Gayanea include its ability to soothe digestive issues and its antispasmodic effects, which help to alleviate muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of Montiopsis gayana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
